channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Waterloo Adds Two New Flavors, Brings Back Fan Favorite
item.description: Waterloo Sparkling Water is expanding its lineup with two new flavors and the return of Lemon Italian Ice following strong consumer demand. The additions reinforce the brand’s focus on bold, authentic flavor with zero calories, sugar or sweeteners.

item.title: How Snacking Trends Reshape US Innovation
item.description: Innova Market Insights finds US snacking is being reshaped by health-driven priorities, blurred meal occasions and demand for bold, craveable formats. From protein-forward and gut-health snacks to smart mashups and frozen innovation, brands face growing pressure to balance wellness, comfort and indulgence.

item.title: Kroger Expands Simple Truth Protein Line
item.description: Kroger is growing its Simple Truth Protein portfolio with 24 new items, bringing the line to more than 110 offerings. The expansion underscores rising demand for affordable, clean-label protein formats designed for everyday wellness and performance.

item.title: Turkey Hill, Entenmann’s Team on Ice Cream
item.description: Turkey Hill and Entenmann’s have partnered to launch two new ice cream flavors inspired by classic baked goods. The collaboration highlights how brands are leveraging familiar desserts and cross-category partnerships to drive indulgence and consumer appeal.

item.title: Delta Beverages Launches Hemp-Infused Spirit
item.description: Infused with a curated terpene profile and crafted from fresh-harvested flowers, the beverage delivers an uplifting bouquet of sativa botanicals.

item.title: TeaPot Introduces Rosin-Infused Blueberry Chamomile Tea
item.description: TeaPot’s new Blueberry Chamomile is a non-carbonated iced tea made with real chamomile and natural blueberry flavor.

item.title: Whirlwined to Debut Hemp-Infused Wine
item.description: Crafted from premium Columbia Valley grapes and finished using dealcoholization technology, Whirlwined is gently de-alcoholized before being infused with hemp-derived THC.

item.title: Extract Labs Introduces Sojourn Hemp THC Seltzers
item.description: Sojourn THC Seltzers are made with full-spectrum, hemp-derived delta-9-THC and crafted for consistent, approachable dosing.

item.title: Willie Nelson’s Hemp Beverage Brand Launches $15M Series A Funding
item.description: Each beverage is crafted with U.S.-grown hemp-derived THC, blended with CBD, CBG and L-theanine for a fast-acting, short-lasting experience.

item.title: Tattersall Distilling Introduces Hemp THC Beverages
item.description: The Tattersall functional beverage lineup includes two mood-based options: Uplift and Unwind.
